compiler_latency_rules.start_advance: start -> command line 0 at the consumer = DEPTH + 4 + 2 edges (r4: DEPTH + 4): issue start 2 edges earlier than r4 (DEPTH + 6 with DEPTH 2). busy/valid/done/edge_index/fault: all +2 edges vs r4 relative to the host start.
compiler_latency_rules.configuration: unchanged at the host pins: writes only while idle, the last write may be on the edge before start; a write on the start edge rejects the start (sticky fault) exactly as r4. The cluster's +2 configuration edges are absorbed by the root's SDLY 2 start delay.
compiler_latency_rules.config_image: bank = 320 x quarter + 32 x column + local bank (local 0..IB-1 packed index, IB.. dictionary); su_programme_compile.py --root5 (replaces --partition 4); bank >= 1280 = sticky out-of-range fault (2 edges later than r4, with the rest)
compiler_latency_rules.reset: root, head and leaves release 3 edges after rst_n (ot_rst_relay): host waits >= 3 edges after reset release before configuring or starting
